subject: Linguistics
title: Spelling and Orthography
description: A 60-second lesson on Spelling and Orthography.

hook.text: 'Through,' 'though,' 'thought,' 'tough'—four different sounds from '-ough.' English spelling is chaotic.

buildup.text: Orthography is a language's spelling conventions—the rules mapping letters to sounds.

discovery.text: Shallow orthographies (Finnish, Spanish) match sounds closely; deep ones (English, French) don't.

twist.text: English spelling preserves etymology—'psychology' keeps its Greek 'ps' even though nobody says it.

climax.text: Spelling reforms succeed in some countries (Turkey, 1928) but face fierce resistance in others.

punchline.text: Spelling is a compromise between sound, history, and tradition.

quiz.question: What is a 'shallow' orthography?
options: One where spelling closely matches pronunciation
